question: Who among the following was the first Indian Governor of Reserve Bank of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CD Deshmukh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chintaman Dwarkanath Deshmukh, a member of the Indian Civil Service, was the first Indian Governor RBI.**
 
• His **association with the Bank **commenced** in 1939 when he was appointed Government's liason officer.**
 
• He later **served as Secretary and thereafter in 1941 as Deputy Governor of the Bank.**
 
• The first governor of RBI was the **British banker Osborne Smith.​**
 
• **Shaktikant Das** is currently serving as the **25th governor **of the Reserve Bank of India. 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **​RBI**

 
 
• ​The Reserve Bank of India was **set up on the basis of the recommendations of the ****Hilton Young Commission****. **
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934** provides the statutory basis for the functioning of the Bank.
 
• RBI **commenced operations on April 1, 1935.**
 
• The Reserve Bank of India was **nationalized with effect on 1st January 1949.** 
 
• Nationalized on the basis of the** Reserve Bank of India (Transfer to Public Ownership) Act, 1948.**
 
• Central Bank of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **HVR Lengar**

 
 
• "H. V. R." Lengar was the** sixth Governor of the Reserve Bank of India.**
 
• **Served **from **1 March 1957 to 28 February 1962.**
 
• Member of the Indian Civil Service.
 
• Also** served as the Chairman of the State Bank of India, **before his appointment as the Governor of the Reserve Bank. 
 
 
 
• **PC Bhattacharya**
 
 
• He was a **member of the Indian Audit and Account Service.**
 
• Served as** Secretary in the Finance Ministry.** 
 
• Later as **Chairman of the State Bank of India prior to his appointment as Governor, RBI.**
 
• The** introduction of the Credit Authorisation Scheme** as an instrument of Credit Regulation,
 
• The **devaluation of the Rupee in 1966.**f
 
• **Key measures taken under him include import liberalization and elimination of export subsidies.**
 
 
 
• **LK Jha​**
 
 
• A **member of the Indian Civil Service.**
 
• Also served as **Secretary to the Prime Minister,** prior to his appointment as Governor.
 
• During his tenure, **social controls over commercial banks were introduced** as an experiment in 1968.
 
• **A National Credit Council was established.**
 
• **14 major commercial banks were nationalized in 1969.**
